dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Dodechahedron was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past history in a home environment is unknown. Dodechahedron has not acclimated well to the shelter environment and has only been allowing for minimal handling from staff. In the kennel, he begins hard barking and retreating to a back corner of his kennel. he has escalated to snapping, growling, lunging, and hard barking during his pickup with officers and similarly during his intake. Once out of the kennel, he remains fearful and will briefly attempt to interact with handlers. Due to these concerns, we recommend that Dodechahedron be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope Rescue partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification using force-free, positive reinforcement-based training to safely manage/modify any behavior he presents with outside of the Care Centers.
dog.name: Dodecahedron
